stacking.note: Up to 8 units (400G per unit) over two built-in QSFP28 ports. Those ports serve as uplinks when not stacking; the VIM slot provides the separate uplinks. Stacking runs in Switch Engine mode only, and can cross-stack with the 5520 at 50G

routing.summary: Dual persona: Switch Engine (EXOS) or Fabric Engine (VOSS). Static, RIP, OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, PIM, VRF, and EVPN. 5+ OSPF interfaces, 3+ BGP peers, IS-IS, and EVPN need a Premier license

routeScale: Switch Engine IPv4 routes: 166,000 (MW models), 294,000 (MXW models); OSPF and BGP with a Premier license
macsec: MACsec 256-bit AES on access and VIM uplink ports (MACsec license required)

power.summary: Two modular hot-swap power supply slots (one required; second for redundancy and PoE); hot-swap fan modules

redundancy.detail: Two hot-swap PSU slots; second PSU for redundancy and additional PoE budget

licensing: Base software license included (most features); Premier license for advanced routing and MACsec license ordered separately. Managed by ExtremeCloud IQ or Extreme Platform ONE, or on-box via CLI/GUI

models.description: 24x 1/2.5/5/10G multi-rate 90W PoE + VIM uplink (Guest VM capable)
models.note: Supports Integrated Application Hosting (Guest VM) with an SSD module and Premier license

models.description: 48x 1/2.5/5/10G multi-rate 90W PoE + VIM uplink (Guest VM capable)
models.note: Supports Integrated Application Hosting (Guest VM) with an SSD module and Premier license
